cues.zh: 我现在在艺术家 Stuart Semple 的工作室里，
cues.en: I'm in the studio of artist Stuart Semple,

cues.zh: 他做出了一种自称“最粉的粉色”的颜料。
cues.en: and he's made what he calls the Pinkest Pink.

cues.zh: 我从五岁起就开始画画，
cues.en: I've been painting since I was five years old,

cues.zh: 也见过很多粉色。
cues.en: and I've seen a lot of pink.

cues.zh: 成千上万的人都用过这种粉色，
cues.en: And thousands and thousands of people have used the pink,

cues.zh: 没人说自己见过更粉的粉色。
cues.en: and nobody's said they've seen a pinker pink.

cues.zh: 这东西真的特别粉。
cues.en: This stuff's really pink.

cues.zh: 我创造了最粉的粉色、最绿的绿色，
cues.en: I've created the pinkest pink, the greenest green,

cues.zh: 最美的蓝色和最黄的黄色。
cues.en: the loveliest blue, and the yellowest yellow.

cues.zh: 我还创造了世界上闪粉效果最强的天然闪粉，
cues.en: I've also created the world's most glittery natural glitter

cues.zh: 以及世界上最哑光、最黑的艺术材料。
cues.en: and the mattest blackest art material in the world.

cues.zh: 大约一年半前，一家名叫 Surrey Nanosystems 的公司
cues.en: About a year and a half ago, a company called Surrey Nanosystems

cues.zh: 宣布他们创造了 Vantablack，
cues.en: announced that they'd created Vantablack,

cues.zh: 一种极其惊艳、比最黑的黑还要黑的黑色材料，
cues.en: which was this really awesome blacker-than-the-blackest-black black

cues.zh: 但他们把独家使用权给了一位名叫 Anish Kapoor 的艺术家，
cues.en: but they gave the exclusive rights to an artist called Anish Kapoor to use it,

cues.zh: 这让很多艺术家很恼火，
cues.en: and that annoyed a lot of artists,

cues.zh: 我也非常生气。
cues.en: and I got really annoyed as well.

cues.zh: 于是我推出了这款“最粉的粉色”（Pinkest Pink）。
cues.en: So I put my Pinkest Pink out.

cues.zh: 我在网站上加了一条免责声明，
cues.en: On the web site I put a disclaimer

cues.zh: 要求购买者必须声明自己不是 Anish Kapoor，也与他毫无关联。
cues.en: that you weren't Anish Kapoor, you weren't associated with Anish Kapoor.

cues.zh: 很多人觉得这挺有意思的，
cues.en: A lot of people thought that was quite funny

cues.zh: 也纷纷下单购买了这款粉色，
cues.en: and a lot of people bought the pink

cues.zh: 不幸的是，Anish Kapoor 本人也设法搞到了一瓶。
cues.en: unfortunately including Anish Kapoor, who managed to get his hands on it

cues.zh: 然后他把手指伸进颜料里蘸了一下，
cues.en: and then he dipped his finger in it

cues.zh: 发到 Instagram 上炫耀自己拿到了这款粉色。
cues.en: and put it on Instagram that he'd got the pink.

cues.zh: 他这么做，既让人觉得有点爽，又让人特别抓狂，
cues.en: It was sort of great and sort of really frustrating when he did that,

cues.zh: 因为一瞬间，我们收到了成千上万的订单，
cues.en: because all of a sudden we were getting thousands and thousands of orders

cues.zh: 最后我们连续熬夜熬了差不多四周来制作粉色颜料，
cues.en: we ended up staying up for about four weeks making pink paint

cues.zh: 别的什么事都顾不上了，
cues.en: and nothing else could happen

cues.zh: 它彻底占据了我们的全部生活。
cues.en: and it just took over our whole life.

cues.zh: 计算机存储颜色的方式五花八门，既复杂又巧妙，
cues.en: There are all sorts of complicated and clever ways that computers can store colour,

cues.zh: 但等到这段视频呈现在你的屏幕上时，
cues.en: but by the time this video reaches your screen

cues.zh: 它本质上就只是一串数值，用来指定
cues.en: it's basically just a series of numbers that say how bright

cues.zh: 红、绿、蓝三种像素的亮度，
cues.en: to make each of the red, green and blue pixels,

cues.zh: 也就是构成你屏幕的那些微小发光点。
cues.en: the tiny lights that make up your screen.

cues.zh: 除非你用的是非常高端、昂贵的屏幕，
cues.en: And unless you've got a really fancy, expensive screen,

cues.zh: 否则这些数值的范围都是 0 到 255——也就是二进制里的 8 个 1。
cues.en: those numbers run from 0 to 255 -- which is eight 1s in binary.

cues.zh: 0 代表关闭像素，255 代表达到最大亮度。
cues.en: 0 means turn the pixel off, 255 means as bright as it can go.

cues.zh: 这意味着你的屏幕大概能显示 1600 万种颜色。
cues.en: That means your screen can show somewhere around 16 million colours.

cues.zh: 但这并不是所有的颜色。
cues.en: But that's not every colour.

cues.zh: 也不包括这一种。
cues.en: And it's not this one.

cues.zh: 因为即使我把这台摄像机对准太阳，你也不会被晃瞎。
cues.en: Because if I pointed this camera at the sun, you wouldn't be blinded.

cues.zh: 这些数值不能超过 255，我没法让你的屏幕亮度超过 100%。
cues.en: The numbers can't go above 255, I can't make your screen go brighter than 100%.

cues.zh: 如果我对准极暗的物体，数值也不能低于 0。
cues.en: And if I point it at something extremely dark, the number can't go below 0.

cues.zh: 我不可能让你的屏幕比关机状态还要暗。
cues.en: I can't make your screen any darker than if it was turned off.

cues.zh: 同理，也存在一些极度浓烈的色彩，
cues.en: In the same way, there are colours that are so intense

cues.zh: 是你的屏幕无法显示的，像素无论如何都达不到那种红、绿或蓝的纯度。
cues.en: your screen can't display them, the pixels cannot go red, green or blue enough.

cues.zh: 这就是其中之一。
cues.en: And this is one of them.

cues.zh: 颜料的种类极其庞大，
cues.en: There are massive libraries of pigments,

cues.zh: 有机的、无机的、合成的、人造的、天然的，
cues.en: organic ones, inorganic ones, synthetic ones, created ones, natural ones,

cues.zh: 人类从最早期就开始发掘它们了。
cues.en: and they've been digging them up since day dot.

cues.zh: “木乃伊棕”就是用磨碎的木乃伊制成的。
cues.en: 'Mummy brown' was made out of ground-up mummies.

cues.zh: 所以你可以订购的颜料库非常庞大。
cues.en: So there's a huge database of pigments that you can order.

cues.zh: 你可以拿它们来尝试。
cues.en: And you can play with them.

cues.zh: 我把这些颜料和粘合剂混合在一起，
cues.en: I've made mixes of these pigments and binders,

cues.zh: 调出一些效果，不断微调，反复推敲让色彩关系到位。
cues.en: created something, tweaked it, and gone back and got these relationships right.

cues.zh: 所以事实上，这算是个挺复杂的小配方。
cues.en: So it's quite a complicated little potion, actually.

cues.en: In a few years' time, technology will move on.

cues.en: It's already possible to buy expensive equipment with a wider colour gamut,

cues.zh: 它们或许就能显示出这种粉色。
cues.en: and that might be able to display this pink.
